type: sudo sh -c 'P=/dev/virtio-ports/hscl.qa; L(){ echo "Q68| $*" >$P; }; chmod -x /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libexec/drkonqi 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p /tmp/cores; sysctl -qw kernel.core_pattern=/tmp/cores/core.%e.%p; ulimit -c unlimited; L control; for i in $(seq 1 8); do timeout 16 /usr/bin/calamares-launch-normal >/tmp/a.$i 2>&1; L "A $i rc=$?"; sleep 2; done; sed -i "s/^  - notesqml/  #- notesqml probe/" /etc/calamares/settings.conf; L seqline; grep -n notesqml /etc/calamares/settings.conf >$P 2>&1; L without; for i in $(seq 1 10); do timeout 16 /usr/bin/calamares-launch-normal >/tmp/b.$i 2>&1; L "B $i rc=$?"; sleep 2; done; L end'
